extraction.Name: Florence Tibbits, nee Pourier
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 160 acre allotment at the time it was issued her; but that the Indian Agency told her that the land would be assessed for taxes, and finally sold for them, if she did not take the patent, so she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1921, she sold her allotment to the State Bank of Scenic, South Dakota, for $500.00 cash
extraction.Buyer: State Bank of Scenic, South Dakota, for $500.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the Indian Agency told her that the land would be assessed for taxes, and finally sold for them, if she did not take the patent
extraction.Occupation/Income: she and her children are supported by her husband, who works for ranchers, this being his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; mother of 5 children, all of whom have good health; she considers that she received a very poor price for her land; has never received any aid from the County, State nor the United States Government; document sworn December 14, 1928
